title: Rehehehe Laugh
blurb: A scheming, nasal little laugh, belonging to somebody whose plan benefits exactly one person. The pitch does the work. Genuine mirth sits lower; this one lives right up in the nose where mischief keeps a flat, and it announces intent before anything has actually happened. Play it when somebody takes the last slice knowing full well what they are doing, wins on a technicality nobody else had spotted, or executes a prank they have clearly been saving up for weeks. Petty victory has a soundtrack now.
